# Emigo.Contents

```m
Emigo.Contents(optional DataRestrictionType as nullable text, optional DataRestrictionValue as nullable text, optional DataRestrictionMode as nullable text, optional AuthorizationMode as nullable text) as table
```

The purpose of the method is to set parameters for odata feed data source calls, thus the non-function calls may be limited by, for example, the period

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Optional |
|---|---|---|
| `DataRestrictionType` | `nullable text` | yes |
| `DataRestrictionValue` | `nullable text` | yes |
| `DataRestrictionMode` | `nullable text` | yes |
| `AuthorizationMode` | `nullable text` | yes |

## Examples (engine metadata — not verified here)
